question: The total in a go-kart team's energy report, in kJ, is 5 times a per-kart figure. The per-kart figure is 26 kJ of fuel reserve added to a net energy that is expressed in kJ. The net energy is 17 J less than the energy of motion of a kart. The kart has a mass of 22 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the second derivative of y = 2x³ - 6x² evaluated at x = 3. What is the total in the report, in kJ?

A 17,000 g projectile flies at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 12. Its energy of motion, plus 28 J of launcher offset, is converted to kJ. The range is 1 km long. Ten shots are fired, so the range total is 10 times the per-shot value, and 15 kJ of reserve is then added. What is the final figure, in kJ?

A 38 kg cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. Its energy of motion plus 9 J of stored spring energy is the per-cart figure. The cart is 1.2 m long. Six carts make a train and 12 trains run per day, so the daily figure is the per-cart value multiplied by 6 and then by 12. What is the daily figure, in J?

A 46 kg cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 6x² at the point x = 2. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. The cart is 1.5 m long. Two carts are coupled and 10 such pairs run, so the total is the per-cart value multiplied by 2 and then by 10. What is the total, in kJ?

The figure at the end of a crane inspection sheet, in kN, is 9 kN of counterweight assist subtracted from a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 4 identical hoists acting together. Each hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 165 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to 9 times the area under y = 4x² + 5x between x = 0 and x = 1. What figure ends the sheet, in kN?

The final figure in a rocket-sled campaign report, in kN, is 27 kN of rail-brake load subtracted from a combined thrust expressed in kN. The combined thrust is that of 10 identical boosters acting together. Each booster supplies the force needed to accelerate a 190,000 g sled at a rate in m/s² equal to 5 times the sum of 2 and 14. What is the final figure, in kN?

The total in a robot-arm report, in kN, is 5 times a floor total. The floor total is 11 times a cell total, and the cell total is 2 times a single-arm force expressed in kN. A single arm supplies the force needed to accelerate a 23,000 g payload at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 4x between x = 1 and x = 3. Each arm has a reach of 1.8 m. What is the total in the report, in kN?

A 6,000 g drone flies at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 12x + 32 = 0. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. The drone flies at an altitude of 80 m. There are 4 drones per team and 9 teams, so the total is the per-drone value multiplied by 4 and then by 9. What is the total, in kJ?

A 14 kg projectile flies at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 4x³ - 2x² at the point x = 2. Its energy of motion, less 16 J of launch loss, is converted to kJ. The range is 600 m long. Two projectiles are fired, so the report doubles the per-shot value. What does the report give, in kJ?

The final figure on a hoist sheet, in kN, is 23 kN of structural allowance added to a combined force that is expressed in kN. The combined force is 2 N more than the sum of 10 identical hoist outputs. Each hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 169 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 9x + 8 = 0. What is the final figure, in kN?

The total in a delivery-cart report, in kJ, is 6 times a per-cart figure. The per-cart figure is 8 J of sensor offset added to the energy of motion of one cart, with that sum then expressed in kJ. Each cart has a mass of 50 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 8x between x = 1 and x = 2. What is the total in the report, in kJ?

The final figure in a press-hall report is expressed in kN, converted from a plant total in N. The plant total is 3 times a hall total, the hall total is 11 times a line total, and the line total is 2 times a single-press force. A single press supplies the force needed to accelerate a 128 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 153 and 378. What is the final figure, in kN?

A 41,000 g crate on a factory conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 2x between x = 0 and x = 3. The drive must supply the force for this plus 5 N of roller friction. There are 12 such conveyors, so the plant total is 12 times the per-conveyor value. A further 12 N of allowance is added to the plant total, and the result is converted to kN. What is the result, in kN?

A 9 kg drone's cruise speed in m/s is found by taking the greatest common divisor of 175 and 360, adding 29, and then subtracting 5. Its energy of motion at that speed is measured. The drone flies at an altitude of 150 m. The fleet has 10 drones per hangar and 11 hangars, so the fleet total is the per-drone value multiplied by 10 and then by 11. What is the fleet total, in J?

A 114,000 g tool head on a press is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 3 times the sum of 8 and 2. The drive must supply the force for this plus 8 N of guide friction, and the total is converted to kN. The press log records a net force defined as that value minus a 24 kN return-spring load plus an 18 kN hydraulic assist, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. What net force does the log record, in kN?

A 20,000 g tool head on a milling machine is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ - 1·x² at the point x = 1. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. The machine log records a net force by subtracting a 20 kN clamping load, then subtracting a 13 kN brake load, then adding a 17 kN hydraulic assist, with the drive direction positive, so it may be negative. What net force does the log record, in kN?

The total in a courier-fleet energy report, in kJ, is 11 times a regional figure. The regional figure is 11 times a depot figure, and the depot figure is 10 times a per-bike figure expressed in kJ. The per-bike figure is the energy of motion of a 20 kg cargo bike moving at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 1·x² at the point x = 1. What is the total in the report, in kJ?

The final figure in an energy report, in kJ, is 14 kJ of reserve added to a fleet total. The fleet total is 11 times a per-unit figure. The per-unit figure is 20 kJ of stored battery energy added to the energy of motion of an 11 kg robot, after that energy has been converted to kJ. The robot moves at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 85 and 231. What is the final figure, in kJ?

An 89,000 g crate is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 3x² + 4x between x = 1 and x = 3. The drive must supply the force for this plus 28 N of roller friction, less 8 N of incline assist. The result is converted to kN. Ten such drives operate, so the plant figure is 10 times the per-drive value. What is the plant figure, in kN?

The final figure on a hoist sheet, in kN, is 22 kN of counterweight assist subtracted from a subtotal. The subtotal is 28 kN of structural allowance added to a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 3 identical hoists, each supplying the force needed to accelerate a 174,000 g load at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 11. What is the final figure, in kN?

The figure a crane operator records, in kN, is 8 times a single-cable net force that is expressed in kN. The single-cable net force is 7 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 176,000 g load at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 3x³ - 4x² at the point x = 1. Eight identical cables share the load. What figure does the operator record, in kN?

The final figure in a press-test report, in kN, is 3 times a per-ram net force, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. The per-ram net force is a drive force expressed in kN minus a 6 kN return-spring load. The drive force is what is needed to accelerate a 77 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to 2 times the smaller root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. The press stroke is 20 cm. What is the final figure, in kN?

A 38,000 g cargo bike moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 5x² at the point x = 1. A depot has 9 such bikes, so the depot's combined energy of motion is 9 times that of one bike. From the depot value, 27 J of timing loss is subtracted. There are 8 depots per region and 4 regions, so the company total is the per-depot value multiplied by 8 and then by 4. What is the company total, in J?

The final figure in a plant report, in kN, is 5 times a hall total. The hall total is 5 times a single-drive net force expressed in kN. The single-drive net force is 22 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 74 kg crate at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 60 and 200. What is the final figure, in kN?

A rider and bike with a combined mass of 60,000 g move at a speed in m/s equal to 8 times the greatest common divisor of 279 and 80. Two riders form a pair, so the pair's combined energy of motion is twice that of one rider. Nine pairs race, so the race total is 9 times the pair value. From the race total, 1 J of timing loss is subtracted. What is the resulting figure, in J?
